en.t: Bleaching shops had existed since ancient times.

units.source_text: 纺织姑娘很少在自己家里曝晒，多半都是拿给曝晒铺去晒的。

en.t: The weaving girls rarely bleached the cloth at home; most of them took it to a bleaching shop to be spread out in the sun.

units.source_text: 白色绉纱织成后，直接铺在雪地上晒；有色绉纱纺成纱线后，则挂在竹竿上曝晒。

en.t: After white crepe was woven, it was laid directly on the snow to bleach; colored crepe was first spun into thread and then hung on bamboo poles to be bleached.

units.source_text: 因为在一月至二月间曝晒，据说也有人把覆盖着积雪的水田和旱地作为曝晒场。

en.t: Because the bleaching was done from January to February, some people are said to have used snow-covered rice fields and dry fields as bleaching grounds.
